main_text.head: Textus VII.
main_text.p: Tandem tamen aliquando manifestis indiciis deprehensi: ad igniculum RaQuorum quidem fraus detecta jam aliquatenus ; sed patronos habentonis, afflictum illum quiem, eluctantem tamen exinervallo, & irradiantem clarius, detecta perfidia, ad jUlices etiam delata nomina; Vanos, qui periculo delegunturAcerrimos habent propugnatores. Boni duces videntur ranis quibusdam & prurientibus ingeniis, quod interlum sine offensa seducant longius: suspenso gradu dum obsecuti, præstolantur Eventum; at eventus ille, non nisi scrobs aut obex: interea nicant ancipiti spe, & ipsâ peri-

page.notes: Marginal notes at right are small italic and partly illegible; the readings given are approximate. The left-edge fragments belong to the adjoining page and were not transcribed. Catchword and signature absent.
